verdict.rationale: Probes confirm AnyDesk serves a live llms.txt index of its Help Center at support.anydesk.com/llms.txt and markdown renditions of its docs (.md with a documentation index), so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs. The llms.txt appears to be a generic help-center knowledge-base index rather than curated agent guidance, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all candidate paths 404). Missing for 10: OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, evidence of agent-specific guidance beyond a generic index, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://support.anydesk.com/llms.txt # AnyDesk Help Center
